description: Configure the 'Participatory Budgeting 2026' survey to display public results while protecting respondent privacy. Login to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!), navigate to the survey, and perform the following: 1) Enable 'Public statistics' and 'Show graphs in public statistics' in the global Presentation settings. 2) Configure the 'Project Preference' question to be visible in public statistics and display as a 'Pie chart'. 3) Configure the 'Priority Score' question to be visible in public statistics. 4) Ensure the 'Zip Code' and 'Household Income' questions are strictly HIDDEN from public statistics. 5) Activate the survey.
